independent_audit.method: Separate implementations score saved numeric activation heads and reconstruct TF-IDF without refitting or model calls. Separate interpretation audit recomputes errors by wording group and world/nested agreement.

interpretation: Nested-question conditioning improves decodability of stipulated prior-state nested labels on four fresh wording groups. Frozen cross-condition primary readouts remain at chance. An unqueried neutral-belief decoder suitable for communication transfer is not validated.
limits: Only four fresh wording groups in the same logical family; sender rows repeat 16 unique inputs.
Fresh materials are agent-assisted and need human semantic review.
World-question control is not length/position matched.
No new answers, behavior improvement, spontaneous belief or causal mechanism was measured.
Sender nested-question negative recall is 0.5 and positive recall is 1.0; legacy validation accuracy is 6/16.
TF-IDF is not a capable full-context text reasoning baseline.
NF4/BF16 local model profile is not a full-precision reference.
No population significance, calibrated-confidence, deception-detection or admission claim.
Pressure transfer needs independently validated matching targets and capture times.
